facts.claim: Brian Halligan and Dharmesh Shah founded HubSpot in 2006.
facts.evidence: Brian Halligan and Dharmesh Shah noticed a major shift in the way people shop and purchase products. Buyers didn’t want to be interrupted by ads, they wanted helpful information. In 2006, they founded HubSpot
Expertly led by CEO Yamini Rangan

facts.claim: HubSpot's global headquarters is in Boston, MA.
HubSpot opened its Europe headquarters in 2013.
